claims: Banksy is an anonymous British graffiti artist, political activist, and filmmaker active since the 1990s.
A March 2026 Reuters investigation identified Banksy as Robin Gunningham (later David Jones).
Robin Gunningham (later David Jones) is a Bristol-born man.
The identification of Banksy as Robin Gunningham remains officially unconfirmed.
Banksy's true identity was a mystery for decades.
Banksy has frequently been rumored to be Robin Gunningham.
Banksy has been rumored to be Massive Attack's Robert Del Naja.
Banksy has been rumored to be artist Neil Buchanan.
Robin Gunningham is considered the most probable identity for Banksy, according to a Yahoo news article and Grove Gallery.
Banksy uses a distinctive stenciling technique to rapidly create images on public walls, says Wikipedia.
Banksy's art focuses on anti-war, anti-capitalist, and anti-establishment themes, as described on Wikipedia.
Banksy's art often features rats, policemen, soldiers, children, and elderly people, as described on Wikipedia.
Banksy started as a street artist.
Banksy's work has been displayed at the British Museum.
Banksy's work has been displayed at the Louvre.
In 2018, Banksy shredded his own artwork "Girl with Balloon" immediately after it was sold for over £1.1 million at auction, notes The Telegraph.
Pest Control is Banksy's authorized authentication body.
Banksy's lawyers and Pest Control protect his identity, according to YouTube.
